title: Shark Tank – School Edition
summary: A school-level Shark Tank event was conducted at SCD Barfiwala High School Auditorium on 27 October 2026 for 350+ students of Grades 9 and 10.
description: A school-level Shark Tank event was conducted at SCD Barfiwala High School Auditorium on 27 October 2026 for 350+ students of Grades 9 and 10. Six Grade 10 teams presented innovative business proposals through PPT presentations and pitched their ideas for funding. Projects included Desk Dock, Shoe Fresh, EcoLoop Waterbottles, ReLab and KisanFresh. Some teams also designed and developed apps to support their business concepts. The judges engaged participants with questions and provided valuable feedback and suggestions. PE Sandip Tarkas, Ms Rahee Ambani and Ms Raena Ambani served as judges. Following the event, Ms Rahee and Ms Raena addressed the girl students of Grades 9 and 10 at the Principal’s request.
location: SCD Barfiwala High School Auditorium, Mumbai, Maharashtra
